title: The Ghost Kings
summary: "The Ghost Kings" by H. Rider Haggard is a mystery-adventure novel published in 1908. Set on the borders of Zululand, it follows Rachel Dove, a British missionary's daughter whose rescue by young Richard Darrien sets destiny in motion. Years later, Rachel faces danger from Ishmael, a villainous renegade, while the Zulus revere her as their divine Inkosazana. Her journey leads to encounters with a lost tribe of mystical seers and tests her gift of second sight in this tale of prophecy, devotion, and supernatural forces.
